text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
At the Christmas Fan Meeting. Surrounded 
by a huge crowd of fans, Curren Chan truly 
felt her popularity soaring, but—

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
On the way home, you come across a scene 
where this year's Oaks winner is being 
enthusiastically celebrated.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
She reaffirmed that showing off her 
brilliance through her running was the 
truest path to becoming even cuter.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
With her sights set on the Triple Tiara, 
Curren Chan aimed for the Fillies' Revue—a 
race longer than her preferred distance.
